entries.basis: Three original reviews of the 2024 animated sequel, not Inside Out (2015): Phil de Semlyen/Time Out, Terry Staunton/Radio Times and Jake Coyle/AP. Exact excerpts and publisher-local June 12 publication dates; Time Out structured June 11 23:00Z is June 12 BST. AP original opened with the primary web reader; original news feed provides June 12 2024 publication rather than the film release day. Scores describe the cited passages, not aggregate star ratings. Radio Times excerpt praises the Joy/Sadness pairing.

entries.basis: Three independent original reviews of Fede Alvarez’s 2024 Alien: Romulus: Phil de Semlyen/Time Out, Peter Bradshaw/The Guardian and Roger Luckhurst/Sight and Sound (BFI). Positive craft assessments and negative originality criticism retained. Publisher-local original dates August 14-16, not subsequent modifications or the release date. Time Out August 14 23:00Z corresponds to its visible August 15 BST publication. Short exact excerpts scored for their tone, not copied star ratings.
